instruction.text: Ramona hands out 30 sweets. She hands out 3 sweets to each person. How many people does she hand out sweets to?
Dohyun puts 40 books on some shelves. He puts 5 books on each shelf. How many shelves does he put his books on?
Lucia picks 90 strawberries. She puts 10 strawberries into each basket. How many baskets of strawberries does she have?
Elijah gives out 14 stamps to his friends. He gives each friend 2 stamps. How many friends does he give stamps to?
Iris has 25 pet fish. 5 fish live in each fish tank. How many fish tanks are there?
Casper puts 60 sheets into his folders. He puts 10 sheets into each folder. How many folders does he put his sheets into?
Freya buys 12 chocolate bars. She gives 6 chocolate bars to each sister. How many sisters does she give chocolate bars to?
Niran sings to a crowd of 80 people. There are 8 people in each row. How many rows of people are there?
